In that setup, the graph is “fully observed” because every node and edge used by the model is constructed directly from the corpus, not inferred from hidden variables: the text itself provides the observable samples, and the graph is just a deterministic representation of those samples. So “sampling from an observable graph” means the model is generating or learning from paths over a graph whose structure is directly available from the data, rather than from an unobserved latent graph that must be estimated.
